item.tib: lag len gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: ces pas zab gsang gcod kyi dgongs spyod las/ ma tsam sbyar chog lag len gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni zab gter gyi skal bzang thob pa'i dbang gi sgron mas gter gzhung las mi bzhugs pas/ cha lag thams cad gter ston rang gis kha bskang na byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che zhes pas don dang nye ba grwa rigs du ma dang rtogs ldan rin po che g.yung drung bstan pa sogs kyis bskul ngor bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pas bris pas/ dge ba'i rgyal bstan rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang smin grol 'phrin las nam mkha'i phar mthar khyab pas (pa'i)rgyu ru gyur cig/
